# Legal Corpus Audit Report (`docs/data/legal_corpus_audit.md`)

- **Audit Date:** 2026-10-29
- **Stage / Step:** Corrective Stage R — Step R1.1
- **Directory Audited:** `data/raw/legal/` (28 PDF files + `manifest.json`)

## 1. Executive Summary (Plain Findings)

**All 28 PDF files (`LEGAL-001` through `LEGAL-028`) committed in `859c32a` were `GENERATED BY YOU` (synthesised in Python via `_build_two_page_pdf_bytes()` in `packages/rag/src/eriwatch_rag/corpus_manifest.py`) and are NOT original downloaded documents.**

- **Original Downloads:** `0 / 28`
- **Generated / Synthesised by Agent:** `28 / 28`

### What Was Wrong

1. **Synthesised PDFs instead of Original Downloads:** Each file is a 2.5–3.1 KB two-page PDF constructed in memory from paraphrased summaries written in `LEGAL_CORPUS_SPECS` inside `packages/rag/src/eriwatch_rag/corpus_manifest.py`.
2. **Non-specific / Unverified URLs:** Many manifest URLs pointed to generic department landing pages (`https://wrd.tn.gov.in/`, `https://www.tn.gov.in/department/26`, `https://greentribunal.gov.in/`, `https://www.cra.tn.gov.in/`) or unverified handle/doc numbers rather than direct downloadable PDF URLs.
3. **Why this is unacceptable:** A grounded legal RAG system (`packages/rag`) cannot claim statutory or judicial grounding if its underlying PDFs were written by the agent rather than downloaded verbatim from official government, legislative, or judicial repositories.

## 3. Remediation Action (Steps R1.2 – R1.6)

1. **Step R1.2:** Delete all 28 generated PDF files (`data/raw/legal/LEGAL-*.pdf`), delete the generated `manifest.json` entries, and remove the PDF synthesis code (`_build_two_page_pdf_bytes` and `LEGAL_CORPUS_SPECS`) from `packages/rag/src/eriwatch_rag/corpus_manifest.py`. Record all 28 SHA-256 hashes in a permanent blocklist (`BANNED_GENERATED_SHA256S`) so `test_corpus_manifest.py` fails immediately if any generated file is ever re-added.
2. **Step R1.3:** Download **only real, unmodified original PDFs** directly from official HTTP(S) URLs (IndiaCode legislative bitstreams, Tamil Nadu Government portal `cms.tn.gov.in` / `tn.gov.in` G.O. PDFs, TNPCB / CPCB / Ministry of Jal Shakti / RRR / PMKSY guidelines, Supreme Court & High Court / NGT orders).
3. **Step R1.4 – R1.6:** Rebuild `data/raw/legal/manifest.json` from the real downloaded files with live URL verification, SHA-256 verification, page-count verification, and manual page-1 inspection of 5 documents.
